lead: `bun nv try` ignores `--ENV--`, so an env-dependent case runs against the machine's own environment.
body: The scratch runner honours `--FILE--` and the expectations but never sets the section's variables, so a `Core\Env` case comes back `whole: 0 of 4` and reads as a broken member. Check an `--ENV--` case with `target/debug/nvs.exe test <path/to/one-case.nvst>`, which takes a single file as well as a tree.
